predictions.rationale: Primary HTTP endpoint for basket operations; exposes add, remove, update, and checkout actions directly matching the feature description.
Concrete repository that stores and retrieves CustomerBasket data in Redis; core persistence logic for all basket changes.
gRPC service surface for basket functionality; enables other services (e.g., BFF gateways) to add/update/checkout baskets.
Domain model representing an entire shopping basket, including buyer id and collection of BasketItem objects.
Domain model for individual items within a basket; supports quantity updates and item data, essential for add/remove operations.
Web BFF component that calls Basket API/Grpc to orchestrate basket operations for the web UI; directly supports basket feature in frontend.
API Gateway controller exposing basket endpoints to SPA/web clients; delegates to BasketService for core logic.
Mobile BFF counterpart service managing basket calls for mobile apps; ensures consistent basket behavior across platforms.
Controller layer in mobile BFF exposing basket endpoints; translates mobile requests into service calls.
Interface defining contract for basket persistence operations; central abstraction used by controllers and services.
